pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Soul-Devouring Grass thrives in places saturated with dark and lingering spiritual energy. Its nearly black leaves possess an unsettling presence. Legends claim the herb absorbs traces of wandering soul essence, making it an ominous discovery for inexperienced cultivators.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Swamps, mangrove swamps, dark forests, soul sand valleys, and the deep dark.
